title: NBF Unlocks Customer Spending Habits With  Lune
desc: We're excited to announce that Lune Technologies has teamed up with the National Bank of Fujairah (NBF).
body: As one of the most well-respected corporate banks in the UAE, National Bank of Fujairah is already renowned for its award-winning services and unwavering commitment to its customers. Yet, in an era where hyper personalization is key, good services aren’t enough to win the hearts of customers. Customers want product that are able to understand them. And to achieve that, data and how it’s presented play a huge part, as it provides bank with the insights and learnings needed to create and develop products that are built on customers’ behaviors and needs.
